name: Relative windings in a box
description: Chase Hendrick's kit windlabel-box around the focus point: chains of sheet crossings grown on the volume's published surface prediction, outward from the attached umbilicus, cut at every step where the published lasagna grad_mag says the step holds more than one sheet, and written as villa's relative_windings.json (winding_is_absolute false) with a flags.json of places to check. It needs an attached umbilicus and refuses without a surface prediction and a grad_mag source; it never computes either. Model output from predictions, not a reading.

inputs.name: prediction
inputs.label: Surface prediction of the open volume (binary, level 0): zarr folder or https URL

inputs.name: grad_mag
inputs.label: Lasagna grad_mag: a manifest (.json or *.lasagna.json URL) or a grad_mag OME-Zarr

inputs.name: base_affine
inputs.label: Prediction voxels to the lasagna base grid: identity, or a JSON 3 x 4 matrix file

inputs.name: box
inputs.label: Box edge in voxels, centered on the focus point
